$comment: Contract for the ResolveImportException server-side command (AD-003, BR-002, FR-002/FR-003). Deployed via the registration console (plugins/OutcomeTesting.Registration) and added to the OutcomeTesting solution via a solution-file import (src/customapis/al_ResolveImportException). Custom API parameter Type codes: 0=Boolean, 10=String.

customApi.name: al_ResolveImportException
customApi.description: Closes an import exception once the row has been dealt with (BR-002, FR-002/FR-003): Resolved when corrected and re-imported, Ignored when it was never a case. The mandatory note is kept separate from the validation reason. Writes an immutable Audit Event.

requestParameters.name: ExceptionId
requestParameters.description: Id of the al_importexception to close.

requestParameters.name: Note
requestParameters.description: Mandatory note recorded on the exception and the Audit Event (BR-012, NFR-AUD-01).

requestParameters.name: IdempotencyKey
requestParameters.description: Stable key for the intent; a replay returns the same closure.

responseProperties.name: Status
responseProperties.description: The status recorded: Resolved or Ignored.

responseProperties.name: AuditEventId
responseProperties.description: Id of the Audit Event written.
